phases.title: Discover
phases.description: Clarify the problem, the market and the constraints.
aiInstructions: Lay out the current situation, target audience, competitors and constraints.
Record the key insights as decisions (what problem to solve, and for whom).

phases.title: Strategy
phases.description: Set the direction and break it into executable actions.
aiInstructions: Break the strategy into verifiable action tasks (scope of ownership, definition of done).
Record the trade-offs as decisions (what to do, what not to do, and why).

phases.title: Execute
aiInstructions: Execute tasks by priority; outputs (decks, documents, spreadsheets) go into artifacts/.
If validate_task_specs is in your tool list, a task that changes how something operates writes its spec delta under tasks/<task-id>/specs/ before it is marked done (nextup_docs/modules/specs.md).
Mark blockers immediately and record who or what they depend on.

phases.title: Measure
aiInstructions: Compare results and gaps against the goals; record the next move (double down, adjust, cut losses) as a decision.

phases.title: Retrospect
aiInstructions: Answer the flywheel prompts and write the reusable methods back into rules.json.
